cards.title: Business Problem
cards.subtitle: Asset Reliability, Maintenance & MRO Inventory
cards.description: Cement plants depend on reliable equipment and timely availability of maintenance spares. Maintenance orders, breakdown notifications, cost postings, equipment attributes, preventive-maintenance plans and material/stock information may sit in separate operational domains. Without a consolidated view, teams can find it difficult to identify the plant or equipment driving downtime, understand maintenance-cost exposure, monitor PM-related breakdown patterns and check whether critical spares are available against reorder parameters.

cards.title: Three Key Business Questions
cards.subtitle: Asset Reliability, Maintenance & MRO Inventory
cards.description: Which plants, equipment categories and assets are contributing most to breakdowns, downtime and production volume loss? Are equipment reliability and maintenance costs visible at plant and equipment level, and which areas require management attention? Which MRO materials are close to or below reorder parameters, and how does the recorded PM compliance status relate to breakdown events?

cards.description: Start with fleet availability, MTBF, MTTR, maintenance cost and volume loss. Use month, plant city, equipment category and top equipment/plant views to locate where breakdowns and downtime concentrate. Action: Prioritise the plant/equipment for reliability review; inspect its breakdown history and maintenance-cost drivers.
